findings.text: The screenshots never reach the task folder: all ten pngs exist only in worktree qf-3, and `.gitignore:184` (`public/framework/ai/**/*.png`) ignores them, so the diff carries no proof and a fresh agent can't see the before/after. They need a force-add (`git add -f`), or the outcome should link them from a tracked place.
The brief asked for drawer shots at 400 **and 1200**. Only 400 exists (`before-*-400.png`, `after-*-400.png`), so the Docs round trip was never checked at 1200, where the drawer is a dock.

Chat v2 docs are stale now that prompts are cards. `ext/Chat/v2/readme.md:3` still says "Each Prompt sits at the root of the chat (no bubbles, no card)", and the comment at `ChatV2.css:4` says "prompts sit at its root with no bubble or card".

`probe.mjs:1` and `v2shot.mjs:1` import `file:///C:/Code/lew42/worktrees/qf-3/Server/Browser.mjs` and hard-code the `qf-3.localhost` host. Once the worktree goes back to the pool, both scripts break or measure the wrong tree. They should import relative to the repo and take the base from `BASE`, which `probe.mjs` already half does.

Ask 1 is met: `after-2-back-on-ai-400.png` shows the chat running full height with no handle and no blank tab area. The cause is correct too. The hide rule moved from `@layer theme` to `@layer util` (`rail.css:399-400`) because `.flex` in util beat it. The `:not(.drawer-rail-sheet-chat-only)` rules at `rail.css:380-386` stay consistent with it.

`.chat-v2-toggle` dropped from `min-height: 44px` to `min-height: 0` with a −.5em margin (`ChatV2.css:14`). That makes the tap target about 28 px tall, under the 44 px ui target. A 44 px box with a negative block margin of the same size would keep it tight without shrinking the target.
`var(--card-bg, #fff)` (`ChatV2.css:7`): no `--card-bg` token is defined anywhere in `styles/`, so the colour is always a hard-coded white. An existing surface token would follow the colour scheme.

`v2-after-400.png`: "show raw" now sits close to its card's bottom edge, so that ask is met. But the shot stops at 900 px inside the scroller, so the new padding below the last task (`padding-block-end` ×4) is not shown in any picture.

Ask 1 is met at both widths: `shots/after-2-back-on-ai-400.png` shows the chat at full height with no handle and no blank tab area, and `shots/after-2-back-on-ai-1200.png` shows the dock's AI tab whole. The fix is the right one: the hide rule moved into `@layer util` (`ext/drawer/rail.css:399-400`), because `.flex` in util had beaten it in theme.

Ask 2 is met: the prompts are cards on `var(--surface)` (`ext/Chat/v2/ChatV2.css:7`), and `shots/v2-after-bottom-1200.png` shows clear room under the last card. "show raw" keeps its 44 px target and sits inside its card (`ChatV2.css:14`, `margin-block: -.8em`).

In `shots/v2-after-400.png` "show raw" still has a little more space above it than below it (the card's padding plus the .6em gap). This is close to "tight to its own card" but not quite there. Trimming the gap above would finish it.
`probe.mjs:4` and `v2shot.mjs:3` have no default base URL, so running either one without an argument or `BASE` set loads `undefined/framework/...`. The usage line on line 1 does say to pass it.
Round 1's four fixes are all closed in f568af8ca:
